spans.quote: The queue test covered 12 jobs using the existing worker and the proposed worker.
Ten jobs completed in both configurations.

constraints.preservation_rule: Twelve jobs across existing/proposed configurations; ten completed in both. Do not turn ten successful jobs into the full test population.

spans.quote: For those ten jobs, median processing time fell from 75 ms to 52 ms with the proposed worker.

constraints.preservation_rule: Median, not mean; 75 ms existing versus 52 ms proposed; comparison applies only to those ten jobs. No production/general speed claim.

spans.quote: Two other jobs failed before producing a timing result and were excluded from that comparison.
We have not established what caused those failures.

constraints.preservation_rule: Two failed before timing, excluded from timing comparison; cause not established. Do not assign failures to a specific worker or assume identical failures in both.

spans.quote: The proposed worker kept the same retry limit of 3.

constraints.preservation_rule: Retry limit unchanged at 3; do not infer number of actual retries.

spans.quote: It used more memory in this test, although peak memory was not recorded.
We therefore cannot quantify the largest increase or use these results to predict peak usage in production.

constraints.preservation_rule: Higher memory observed here; peak not recorded; largest increase unquantifiable; production peak cannot be predicted from this test. No invented metric or size.

spans.quote: The test did not include concurrent clients.
I would like to repeat the test with concurrent clients before recommending a rollout.

constraints.preservation_rule: Original test lacks concurrent clients; author wants retest with them before recommending rollout. Retain before-recommendation sequence without upgrading preference to a scheduled commitment.

spans.quote: That repeat has not been scheduled, and no production change has been approved.

constraints.preservation_rule: Retest unscheduled and production change unapproved. Neither is resolved by editing.

spans.quote: The review note must state both the ten-job denominator for the timing comparison and the two excluded failures.

constraints.preservation_rule: Mandatory explicit disclosure of both denominator and excluded failures. Reporting them once elsewhere does not automatically preserve the obligation for the review note.

spans.quote: Before approving a rollout, the service owner should review the memory measurements from the repeat test.

constraints.preservation_rule: Service owner should review repeat-test memory measurements before approving rollout. Keep actor, should-review strength, memory subject, repeat-test source, and pre-approval timing; measurements are not yet available.

unresolved: Failure cause, peak memory, concurrent-client performance, retest schedule, and approval remain unknown. Do not fill these gaps or invent a rollout date.
